answer: One state-registered vessel anchors each identity: its hull number enters the lagoon registry with a 20 POA bond locked 120 days. Each further vessel from one wallet locks 20 POA more than the last, so the nth vessel costs 20n POA and 100 fakes lock 101,000 POA plus 15,000 POA in registration fees, against 20 POA honest. Each epoch an opal seal re-attests the vessel within 72 hours; two misses halve the bond and halt payouts 3 epochs, and a reused hull voids both bonds. A tundra port vessel passes its annual safety inspection. One shared family boat passes with co-owner signatures.
